notes.title: Small quality of live update
notes.content:
Hi thank you all for the support 😊, here's a small quality of live update with some quick changes:


 Allow for game mode selection before starting an online match.
 Change map selection algorithm so you don't play the same maps quite as often.
 Online: If the host doesn't start the game within 8 seconds after all players are ready, the game will start automatically now.
 Disabled the inverted steering powerup for now.


We're also working on the soccer ranking glitches and other small stuff.

If you have any feedback or bugs please write us!

notes.title: What to expect from the Caravan Chaos Demo
notes.content:
Caravan Chaos 
Caravan Chaos is a multiplayer game about launching caravans at each other. Build momentum and detach your caravan at the right moment to hit devastating shots.

Caravan Chaos features online and local multiplayer for up to four people. You can play a variety of game modes (Last Van Standing, Soccer, Hot Potato) with unique crazy caravan classes. 
Get together some friends and play in local or online multiplayer!

The demo gives you a small taste of what to expect from the full version:

Demo Content

 Online multiplayer
 Local multiplayer
 1 game mode: Last Van Standing
 5 caravan classes
 2 maps


Controller recommended, mouse only needed for Steam invite overlay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38842655/223e2f15d9b96580318cc3d278c6998ad134b4bc.gif

About us

We're two indie developers from Austria developing the game part-time. Caravan Chaos started as a student project and after graduation, we started working on online multiplayer with the goal of releasing on Steam eventually.
